core.title: Code-It Electronic Security Lever, Mul-T-Lock LCK-CODE-IT

text.description_html:
Mul-T-Lock Code-It Keypad Lever

Mul-T-Lock’s Code-It Lever is perfect for offices, storage rooms, or any interior room where you want to control the access with as little fuss as possible. It simplifies frequent exit and entries where you'll always want to be able to maintain a level of security without having to worry about carrying around a key or even locking the door behind you. The Code-It lever has two operational modes: the first is automatic locking, where the door locks behind you every time, and the second is manual locking, where the door locks with the press of a button. This leverset is for interior use only. It features easy, wire-free installation; a professional should be able to install this lever in under 5 minutes.

Features of the Code-It Electronic Security Handle:

  • Will replace most existing handle types.
  • For interior use.
  • Programmable 4 to 6 digit code with up to 9 different codes for separate users.
  • Wireless installation.
  • Up to 100,00 entries with one pair of batteries.
  • Battery life indication light.
  • Easy installation. Secures to the inside of the door, preventing disassembly from the outside.

Specifications of the Mul-T-Lock Code-It Keypad Security Lever:

  • Finish: US26D Satin Chrome
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-1/4” through 2-1/4” (32 - 57 mm)
  • Backset: available for either 2-3/4" or 2-3/8"
  • Handed: Not Reversible (Select Handing Below)

Two Programable Operating Functions:

  • Passage (Manual Locking): Locks by pushing the button on the exterior lever. Inside lever always unlocked.
  • Storeroom (Automatic Locking): Outside lever always locked. Entry by code only. Inside lever always unlocked.

Available only in Satin Chrome Finish.

*Must Select Handing Below
